LanguageData.VWEB_HeavyIncineratorVaporizer.descripti: Fire a short-ranged vaporizer stream, melting everything in front of the user. This burner works a little bit differently than the hellcat one. Instead of being a typical firespew, it’s more like an Incinerator arc.
LanguageData.VWEB_HeavyIncineratorVaporizer.label: heavy incinerator vaporizer
